entities.summary: Thomas Henry Armstrong was a Minnesota banker, lawyer, legislator, and the fifth lieutenant governor of Minnesota. He became Lieutenant Governor under Governor William Rainey Marshall from January 8, 1866, to January 7, 1870. Armstrong served in the Minnesota Constitutional Convention and both houses of the Minnesota State Legislature. He died in 1891 in Albert Lea, Minnesota.
